sloka: नमस्कृत्वा ऽथ रामाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः।राघवार्थे परं कर्म समीहतपरन्तपः ।। ६.७४.४८ ।।
transliteration: namaskṛtvā 'tha rāmāya mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ।rāghavārthe paraṁ karma samīhataparantapaḥ ।। 6.74.48 ।।

translations.english: Maruti, scorcher of enemies, endowed with terrific valour offered prayers to Sri Rama and made up his mind to embark on the stupendous task for Raghava.
